mentions.name: App-assisted real-life puzzle game
mentions.description: A real-life puzzle game that is app/mobile assisted, with a backend and an iOS app built as a usable prototype. A free/MVP version is being prepared for launch with a non-tech co-founder contributing subject matter expertise, aimed at everyday people having fun.
mentions.audience: Everyday people looking to have some fun
mentions.source_excerpt: I always wanted to build a real-life puzzle game, which is app/mobile assisted. Had yet another eureka moment, and built a usable prototype (backend plus iOS app).

evidence.value: I always wanted to build a real-life puzzle game, which is app/mobile assisted. Had yet another eureka moment, and built a usable prototype (backend plus iOS app).
